technology.short_description: Weapons are an extension of the self. Literally, in some cases, where viscous slime welds weapons to flesh.

effects.description: Weapon strength: +3% per experience rank for all Great Weapons units
Attribute: Cause Fear for all great weapon units (rank 4 and above)

related_attributes.bullet_text: This unit frightens all enemy units, reducing their leadership when nearby. It is also immune to fear. Fear penalties do not stack.

technology.short_description: Endless experiments pave the way for better understanding the putrid magics of decay.

effects.description: Passive ability: "Cloud of Flies" for Aspiring Champions and Chosen of Nurgle units
Passive ability: "Regeneration" for Aspiring Champions units
Cooldown: -10% to Lores of Nurgle and Death spells

ui_effects.localised_text: Reflects melee damage dealt to unit back at the attacker

technology.short_description: Those bearing Nurgle’s morbid mark carry corruption with them, wherever they trudge.
Be it by rot, or simply His overwhelming presence, Nurgle grants ways to sap the unyielding strength from even the most fortified bastion gates.
Symbols of sickness are but a source of strength to the mortals seeking the Plague Lord's embrace.
Daemonic steeds are driven by unnatural hunger, carrying mortals sworn to Chaos into battle in search of prey.

effects.description: Unlocks Warband upgrades: Gorebeast Chariots, Doom Knights, Rot Knights and Skullcrushers
Unit experience gain: +25% for Chaos Knights

technology.short_description: Through fervent prayer to the Urfather, His mortal followers are reborn as children of pox and pestilence.

effects.description: Passive ability: "Slime Trail" for Aspiring Champions, Putrid Blightkings and Chosen of Nurgle units
Vigour loss reduction: -25% for Chosen of Nurgle and Chaos Warriors of Nurgle units

technology.short_description: The dark rites must be performed, if the chosen are to rise among the ranks of Ruin.

effects.description: Unlocks Warband upgrades: Chosen
Unit experience gain: +25% for Chaos Warriors

technology.short_description: The arms of a Chaos Knight are imbued with a small but not inconsequential amount of Unholy power.

effects.description: Unlocks Warband upgrades: Chaos Knights
Enables magical attacks for Chaos Knights units

technology.short_description: Chaos Armour, inscribed with powerful litanies of hate, will glow hot and vengeful when struck.
Kings, tzars, and emperors alike all fall to the same truth: no crown can shield its bearer from Grandfather’s embrace.
A worthy Beastmaster needs no chains to direct the ferocious nature of his darling pets.

effects.description: Melee attack: +8 for Chaos Warhounds, Feral Manticore and Chimera units
Passive ability: "Gorefeast" for Chaos Warhounds, Feral Manticore and Chimera units (Rank 4 and above)

technology.short_description: Nurgle's mark reeks of Rot and decay, encapsulating the source of His power.
The host that garners the Plaguefather’s approval grows ever more accomplished at spreading His gifts.
Let the Marauders gather under their Ruinous masters' eternal gaze.
Engineers have perfected a wicked machine of war, drawn by fearsome steeds into the very heart of battle.

effects.description: Unlocks Warband upgrades: Chaos Chariots and Hellstriders
Unit experience gain: +50% for Marauder Horsemen

technology.short_description: A pact with the Dark Gods should not be taken lightly.
Such massive iron bands are a marvel to behold, lending strength to the swing of the most colossal creatures.

effects.description: Weapon strength: +20% for Plague Ogres, Chaos Trolls, Chaos Giant, Chaos Siege Giant, Cockatrice, Champions of Slaanesh, Mutalith Vortex Beast, Slaughterbrute, Chimera, Dread Maw, Giant Spined Chaos Beast, Basilisk and Pleasureseekers units

Missile resistance: 20% for Plague Ogres, Chaos Trolls, Chaos Giant, Chaos Siege Giant, Cockatrice, Champions of Slaanesh, Mutalith Vortex Beast, Slaughterbrute, Chimera, Dread Maw, Giant Spined Chaos Beast, Basilisk and Pleasureseekers units (Rank 4 and above)

technology.short_description: All hope to catch the attention of the Gods, gathering where they think the Chaos Gods will be looking.
"Come to my side, o pestilent comrades. Through me, the Urfather's withering touch shall restore and renew you."
All those who walk the path of Rot may yet ascend to glorious Daemonhood.
The Chaos Gods grow impatient. Lending a sliver of majesty, they enable their followers to march faster.

effects.description: Battle reinforcement time: -50%
Campaign movement range: +5% for armies

technology.short_description: Tributes and monuments to the Dark Powers ensure the Chaos Gods' favour.
Such a generous gift is the thousand twisted blessings. Think of all the needle-teeth and tentacles it bestows.

effects.description: Unlocks Warband upgrades: Forsaken
Melee attack: +5 for Chaos Spawn units

technology.short_description: The elite of the Chaos Warriors are the Chosen and the Chaos Knights. They are the Dark Gods' willing slaves.
The battlefields of the conquered yield a bountiful harvest to Nurgle's servants, be it in coin, future plague carriers, or the souls of those caught alive.
Corruption festers like a deadly contagion, with its price paid in a deluge of souls.
Brought together under the common cause of Ruin, the Chaos-aligned hordes shall bring the world to its knees.
Nought but the hottest holy fires of purification can stem the spill of the plagues of the Dark Gods once they are unleased on the world.
Every corpse-strewn battlefield left nourished in Rot becomes fertile ground for the next bloom of corruption.
Those who march at the helm of Nurgle’s hosts do so with aplomb, earning His regard as they joyously carrying out His malignant will.
Where this ooze-like rain drenches the ground, a noisome fungus grows, as the gibbering hoots of otherworldly creatures echo out in warning: Nurgle watches these tainted lands.
Old Sawbones welcomes those marked by the Urfather.

effects.description: Path to Glory: +50% levels kept when devoting a character to Nurgle
Hero capacity: +2 for Exalted Heroes
Enables direct recruitment of Marked Exalted Heroes
